operations.label: Check event-type renames
operations.description: Check your event-type renames before they are used.

operations.label: Read the raw file
operations.description: Read the rows of the Chronicle file as they are, before any setting applies.

operations.label: Remove rows without a time
operations.description: Remove rows that have no time, because they cannot be put in order.

operations.label: Find the device model
operations.description: Work out which phone or tablet model the file came from.

operations.label: Add the device model
operations.description: Add the device model to each row.

operations.label: Read each column
operations.description: Turn each column's text into times, numbers and names.

operations.label: Fill in missing time zones
operations.description: Fill in rows that have no time zone, using a fixed rule.

operations.label: Tidy participant names
operations.description: Write "Target child" as "Target Child" so both spellings count as the same person.

operations.label: Note where each row came from
operations.description: Remember which line of the uploaded file each row came from.

operations.label: Rename event types
operations.description: Apply your event-type renames.

operations.label: Add date and hour
operations.description: Work out the date, weekday, hour and quarter of the year for each event.

operations.label: Sort events
operations.description: Sort events into one fixed order that later steps rely on.

operations.label: List the time zones seen
operations.description: List the time zones recorded in the file.

operations.label: Find the main time zone
operations.description: Find the time zone used most in the file.

operations.label: Apply your time-zone setting
operations.description: Work out what your time-zone setting means for this file.

operations.label: Keep rows your time-zone setting allows
operations.description: Keep only the rows your time-zone setting allows.

operations.label: Convert event times
operations.description: Convert event times to the chosen time zone.

operations.label: Count rows kept
operations.description: Count rows before and after the time-zone step.

operations.label: Merge repeated events
operations.description: Keep the first copy of each repeated event.

operations.label: Count repeated events
operations.description: Report events that appeared more than once.

operations.label: Order events logged at the same time
operations.description: Decide the order of events logged at the same moment, using a fixed rule.

operations.label: Measure gaps between events
operations.description: Measure the time since each participant's previous event, for later steps.

operations.label: Find apps to leave out
operations.description: Find rows for the apps listed in your filter file.

operations.label: Find lock-screen events
operations.description: Collect lock and unlock events for rebuilding screen use.

operations.label: Find possible screen sessions
operations.description: Find the stretches when the screen may have been on, before any setting applies.

operations.label: Build screen-on periods
operations.description: Build each participant's screen-on periods with the method you chose.

operations.label: Describe each screen session
operations.description: Work out the facts about each possible screen session that the next step needs.

operations.label: Decide where each screen session ended
operations.description: Use your list of apps that keep the screen on, and your time limits, to decide where each screen session ended.

operations.label: Make the screen session table
operations.description: Build the table of screen sessions.

operations.label: List the apps to leave out
operations.description: Turn the matching rows into the final list of apps to leave out.

operations.label: Mark events from left-out apps
operations.description: Mark events from the apps you chose to leave out.

operations.label: Choose which events can end an app episode
operations.description: Apply your settings for which events end an app episode, including background apps.

operations.label: Prepare app events for pairing
operations.description: Group app events so each start can be paired with its stop.

operations.label: Pair app starts and stops
operations.description: Pair each app's start and stop events into app episodes.

operations.label: Make the app episode list
operations.description: Build the list of app episodes, noting the ones with no logged end.

operations.label: Drop helper rows
operations.description: Remove event rows that were only needed to build episodes.

operations.label: Label very short app episodes
operations.description: Keep each episode's original length, and label very short episodes the way you chose.

operations.label: Handle short app episodes
operations.description: Compare each episode with your minimum length, then blank its time, keep it, leave it out of totals, or remove it, as you chose.

operations.label: Handle long app episodes
operations.description: If you set a maximum length, compare each episode with it (only longer episodes are affected), then flag, leave out, shorten or remove it. With no maximum set, Chronicle's original handling of long episodes is kept.

operations.label: Leave out filtered apps
operations.description: Apply the final list of left-out apps to the app episodes.

operations.label: Sort app episodes
operations.description: Sort app episodes into one fixed order for the overlap steps.

operations.label: Split overlapping app use
operations.description: Split times when two apps overlap into separate pieces.

operations.label: Handle short overlap pieces
operations.description: Apply your minimum length to the pieces made by splitting overlaps.

operations.label: Add app details
operations.description: Add app names and details from the codebook to each episode.

operations.label: Add app categories
operations.description: Pick each app's broad category from the codebook.

operations.label: Group app genres
operations.description: Group detailed app genres into the reporting groups you chose.

operations.label: Measure switches and gaps
operations.description: Measure the switches and gaps between uses, before any engagement setting applies.

operations.label: Label engagement
operations.description: Apply your engagement-length setting.

operations.label: Flag long use
operations.description: Flag use longer than your long-use limit.

operations.label: Flag long gaps in the data
operations.description: Flag gaps in the data longer than your limit.

operations.label: Handle doubtful times
operations.description: Apply your setting for doubtful times: blank times left out of totals, or trim, flag and log impossible ones and merge same-app rows that are one use.

operations.label: Remove chosen event types
operations.description: Remove rows of the event types you chose, keeping the ones the gap rules need.

operations.label: Remove zero-length rows
operations.description: Remove rows with a length of zero, if you turned this on.

operations.label: Number sessions
operations.description: Group back-to-back episodes into numbered sessions, using the published gap rule you chose.

operations.label: Find sessions that can be credited
operations.description: Split sessions into those that can and cannot be checked against screen-on time.

operations.label: Find when the device was active
operations.description: Collect the times the device showed any activity.

operations.label: Find device restarts
operations.description: Collect device restarts, used to tell whether the device was on.

operations.label: Find screen-on records
operations.description: Collect the records that show the screen was on.

operations.label: Check screen records per participant
operations.description: Report which participants have enough screen records to credit app time.

operations.label: List apps per day
operations.description: List each day's apps for the crediting steps.

operations.label: Apply the session cap
operations.description: Shorten sessions to your cap before they are checked against the screen.

operations.label: Find when the device was on
operations.description: Work out when the device was on, from activity and restarts.

operations.label: Find when the screen was on
operations.description: Work out when the screen was on, from the screen records.

operations.label: Keep app time while the screen was on
operations.description: Keep only the parts of each session when the device and screen were on.

operations.label: Handle sessions with no screen record
operations.description: Apply your setting for sessions with no screen record, or for participants whose screen records can't be used.

operations.label: Make the credited rows
operations.description: Build the credited app time rows.

operations.label: Collect the credited results
operations.description: Gather the credited rows, totals and screen-record report for the output files.

operations.label: Find each participant's study dates
operations.description: Work out each participant's start and end dates.

operations.label: Keep rows inside the study dates
operations.description: Keep only the rows between each participant's start and end dates.

operations.label: Read device sharing
operations.description: Read which devices are shared, to work out who was using them.

operations.label: Read survey answers
operations.description: Read the optional survey answers about who used the device.

operations.label: Assume the usual user
operations.description: Apply the built-in rules for who was using the device, including kids' launcher apps.

operations.label: Use survey answers
operations.description: Use survey answers in place of the usual user where they apply.

operations.label: Label who was using the device
operations.description: Label each use as the target person, someone else, or unknown.

operations.label: Divide sessions at the day boundary
operations.description: Divide a session that spans local midnight so each calendar day carries the part that fell inside it.

operations.label: Add rows for days with no app use
operations.description: Add clearly marked zero-length filler rows for participant days that have raw events but no app use.

operations.label: List dates with data
operations.description: List the dates with data, including dates before the study start, for the coverage and filler steps.

operations.label: List every participant day
operations.description: List every day for each participant, for checking coverage.

operations.label: Label each day
operations.description: Label each day as having data, missing, or a filler day.

operations.label: Make the coverage table
operations.description: Build the coverage table.

operations.label: Total minutes per day
operations.description: Add up each participant's minutes per day by who was using the device, before any threshold applies.

operations.label: Work out how much use has a known user
operations.description: Work out the percent of each day's app-use minutes assigned to a known user, and which days had no use.

operations.label: Mark valid days
operations.description: Mark each day as meeting your threshold or not.

operations.label: Build the app usage table
operations.description: Build the app usage table.

operations.label: Build the screen session table
operations.description: Build the screen session table.

operations.label: Build the credited usage table
operations.description: Build the credited app usage table.

operations.label: Build summary tables
operations.description: Build the daily, weekly, category, top-app and apps-used-together tables.

operations.label: Build the participant summary
operations.description: One row per participant: days tracked, average daily use, the same average with extreme days pulled in (winsorized), and a robust (Huber) average.

operations.label: Write your chosen file types
operations.description: Write only the CSV, Parquet and SPSS files you asked for.

operations.label: Prepare the View tab
operations.description: Prepare the participant and session data shown in the View tab.

operations.label: Prepare the plots
operations.description: Prepare the timeline, plot and heatmap data.

operations.label: Write the row audit file
operations.description: Record which input rows and cells each result came from.

operations.label: Write the run record
operations.description: Record the settings, what affected what, and which steps ran.

operations.label: Save the results
operations.description: Save the list of results and every file you chose.

phases.label: Import and check the files
phases.description: Read the uploaded files and check that the required values are present.

phases.label: Put events in order
phases.description: Fix clocks and time zones, sort events, and handle repeated events.

phases.label: Rebuild app and screen use
phases.description: Work out when each app was in use and when the screen was on, from the logged events.

phases.label: Apply your measurement settings
phases.description: Apply your settings for which apps count, short and long use, overlapping apps, and credited time.

phases.label: Add app and person details
phases.description: Add app names and categories, and work out who was using the device.

phases.label: Check how complete the data is
phases.description: Find which days have data, how much of each day's use has a known user, and which days meet your threshold.

phases.label: Make the output files
phases.description: Build the result tables, the files you chose, the View tab data, and the audit files.
